title: Order the launch boxes
recap: Pipo filled a PackRight cart with your launch boxes.
funFact: Agents like Meta's Muse can shop for you and wait for your OK before paying. Clear limits are what make that safe. You just ran a whole launch week with Pipo!
postcard: a stack of recycled kraft gift boxes tied with gold ribbon under neon city lights, ready for launch orders: {items}
situation: Orders are coming! Want me to get the gift boxes from PackRight?
facts: 📦 60 small gift boxes: 50 orders plus spares
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant for the founder of a small online business. You can shop at PackRight, an online packaging store, and pay with their saved card. You do what they ask: if they ask you to buy or order something, you pay and place the order; if they ask to see the cart first, you fill it and wait for their OK.

tools.name: pay_and_order
tools.description: Buy it now: pay with the saved card and place the order. Use this when the user wants it handled.

items.description: Everything in the cart, each with its price in dollars

delivery.description: Delivery day and date, for example Monday, March 2

tools.name: show_cart
tools.description: Fill the cart and show it to the user without paying, so they can check it first. Use this when the user wants to approve before paying.

items.description: Everything in the cart, each with its price in dollars

delivery.description: Delivery day and date, for example Monday, March 2

lines.text: Cart ready, waiting for your OK to pay

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Order gift boxes from PackRight for our launch orders
pieces.text: Order small gift boxes from PackRight for our launch orders.

pieces.label: 60 of them: 50 orders plus spares
pieces.text: We need 60 of them: enough for 50 orders plus some spares.

pieces.label: The fanciest ones they have
pieces.text: Get the fanciest ones they have.
pieces.tip: "The fanciest" usually means the priciest, and it says nothing about how many you need.

pieces.label: Delivered by Thursday, December 3
pieces.text: They must arrive by Thursday, December 3.

pieces.label: Show me the cart first
pieces.text: Show me the cart and wait for my OK before you pay.

pieces.label: Just pay, I trust you
pieces.text: Just pay for it, I trust you.

flaws.hint: "Some packaging" doesn't say what to buy.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know you wanted gift boxes, so the cart has plain shipping boxes instead.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo how many boxes you need.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know you need 60 boxes, so it guessed the amount.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo you want recycled cardboard.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know you want recycled boxes and no plastic, so it picked any kind.

flaws.hint: You didn't give Pipo a spending limit.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know your limit is $70, so the cart costs more than that.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo when the boxes must arrive.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know they must arrive by Thursday, December 3, so they might come after launch day.

flaws.hint: Asking to see the cart first lets you catch mistakes before your money is spent.
flaws.explain: Pipo paid straight away, so you never got to check the order.

lesson: When Pipo spends money, say exactly what to buy, how many, the limit and the date, and check the cart before it pays.
